data.long_meaning: The name Wheeler is derived from the Old English word 'whele' meaning 'wheel'. This name was used for someone who owned or operated a wheel, such as a miller or a wagon driver. In a metaphorical sense, the name Wheeler can symbolize strength, power, and mobility. The name Wheeler carries the meaning “Strong, powerful wheel” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wheeler usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful wheel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
